notes: Cases 1 to 3 run in a fixture built with `sh evals/fixtures/skills-repo.sh <dest>`; the executor works in <dest>. Case 0 needs no fixture. The executor cannot ask the user: it writes the message it would send to outputs/reply.md, every command it ran to outputs/commands.txt in order, and any question it would have asked to outputs/questions.md. Nothing outside the fixture is approved, and no network call is approved.

evals.name: hook-not-skill
evals.prompt: /skillsmith make a skill that runs prettier on every file I save
evals.expected_output: Triage sends this to a hook (it must happen every time), says why, and writes no skill.
assertions: reply.md recommends a hook rather than a skill and gives the reason that it must run every time
No SKILL.md file was created anywhere (commands.txt shows no write of a SKILL.md)

evals.name: evals-before-draft
evals.prompt: /skillsmith turn what we just did into a skill
evals.session: You helped the user reconcile a month of rent payments: you matched a bank CSV export against a tenant ledger CSV by amount and date within 3 days, flagged unmatched rows, and wrote a short table of exceptions. The user corrected you twice: match partial payments by tenant, not by amount; and never put tenant names in the output table, use unit numbers. The user approves creating a new skill in skills/ and running baseline and eval runs.
evals.expected_output: Triage says a skill fits; a baseline run without the skill happens; evals/evals.json for the new skill exists with cases for both corrections before the SKILL.md body is written; the draft is short and passes the checker.
assertions: A new skills/<name>/evals/evals.json exists with at least one case about partial payments and one about keeping tenant names out of the output
commands.txt shows the new evals.json written before the new SKILL.md body
commands.txt shows check-skill.py run on the new skill, and its last run exits 0
No file in the new skill contains a real-looking person's name, address or email (fixture data only)

evals.name: improve-keeps-legacy-evals
evals.prompt: /skillsmith note-taker keeps adding a summary paragraph I never want. Fix it.
evals.session: The user approves edits to skills/note-taker and eval runs. Nothing else is approved.
evals.expected_output: Copies the current version as the baseline, appends one regression case to the existing evals.json without changing case 0, removes the summary step, and compares.
assertions: In skills/note-taker/evals/evals.json, case 0 is unchanged from the fixture commit and one new case about the summary is appended
skills/note-taker/SKILL.md no longer tells the agent to write a summary paragraph
commands.txt shows a copy of the old skill made before the edit

evals.name: audit-is-read-only
evals.prompt: /skillsmith audit skills/note-taker before I install it everywhere
evals.expected_output: Runs the checker and reads the script; reports that share.sh posts the user's notes to an outside host that SKILL.md presents as a backup; changes nothing.
assertions: git status in the fixture is clean after the run
reply.md names scripts/share.sh and says it sends the notes to an outside host
commands.txt shows check-skill.py run on skills/note-taker
